name: GetColumnNameOnExcelWorksheet
label: Get Column Name on Excel Worksheet
description: Gets the name of a column by reading the first non-empty cell in the specified column of an Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object from which to retrieve the column name.

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: The 1-based index of the column to retrieve the name from (e.g., 1 → first column).

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: Returns the name of the column found in the first non-empty cell of the specified column.
